pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: HeyMaa Subscription
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits you

items.question: What is HeyMaa?
items.answer: HeyMaa is your digital companion through motherhood: AI chat, a family tree, a memory journal, and milestone tracking — all in one app.

items.question: What can I do in the app?
items.answer: Chat with HeyMaa (text or voice), add family members, save memories with photos and videos, track development milestones, and browse offers — depending on your plan.

items.question: What does the free trial include?
items.answer: 14 days to try HeyMaa: unlimited chat, up to 50 voice playbacks (Listen) per month, and basic memory. No credit card required to start.

items.question: What happens when the trial ends?
items.answer: If you don't upgrade, app access stops. You'll get a reminder before expiry. Choose a plan from Settings → Subscription or contact us at info@heymaa.ai.

items.question: How do voice messages work?
items.answer:
The monthly limit applies to voice playbacks of HeyMaa's replies (Listen button). Your remaining quota appears above the chat.

• Trial: 50/month
• Starter: 150/month
• Premium: 400/month
• Annual Premium: 700/month

You can speak in chat using the microphone (speech-to-text) without using this quota.

items.question: What's the difference between plans?
items.answer:
All plans include unlimited chat. Voice playbacks and memory differ:

• Trial: 50 voice playbacks, basic memory
• Starter (€19/month): 150 voice playbacks, full memory
• Premium (€39/month): 400 voice playbacks, full memory
• Annual Premium (€199/year): 700 voice playbacks, full memory

See the Pricing section for details.

items.question: What is Basic vs Full Memory?
items.answer: Basic Memory (free trial) lets you capture and organize memories. Full Memory (Starter and above) unlocks the full memory experience — journal, photos, videos, and organization by family member.

items.question: Does HeyMaa give medical advice?
items.answer: No. HeyMaa does not replace a doctor or pharmacist. For any health concern — yours or your child's — always speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: We support 17 languages: Greek, English, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Romanian, Bulgarian, Polish, Serbian, Arabic, Turkish, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese, and Dutch. Change language in Settings → Language.

items.question: How do I upgrade my subscription?
items.answer: Open Settings → Subscription, pick a plan, and complete checkout. Your active plan is shown there.

items.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Cancellation is not yet available directly in the app. Email info@heymaa.ai or use Help & support in Settings. For monthly plans, auto-renewal stops and you keep access until the period ends. On the annual plan, the discounted price (-57%) applies until expiry.

items.question: I forgot my password
items.answer: On the sign-in screen, tap Forgot password? and follow the link sent to your email.

items.question: Do I need an invite code?
items.answer: Usually not — you can sign up with email and password. If you were given an invite code, enter it at registration. Share your invite code from Profile to earn +50 points when a friend signs up.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes — your data belongs to you. You can export a copy (JSON) or delete your account from Settings → Privacy & data. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
